findings.evidence: Forward trace from the flagged location: Mikrofonbefund.kt:39-41 reads Build.MANUFACTURER, Build.MODEL, Build.HARDWARE and Mikrofonbefund.kt:56-63 reads AudioDeviceInfo.productName / .address into a plain-text report string built by Mikrofonbefund.erhebe(). The only caller is ForschungActivity.kt:370-371 (starteMikrofonbefund -> lege("audiobefund.txt", Mikrofonbefund.erhebe(this))). The sink, ForschungActivity.kt:374-380, is purely local: File(getExternalFilesDir(null), name).writeText(bericht) plus Log.i("NibraBefund", ...) to logcat, then rendered on screen. No off-device sink exists: a repo-wide grep for URL(, HttpURLConnection, openConnection, OkHttp, Retrofit, Ktor, HttpClient and Socket( across app/src/forschung, app/src/main and simple-keyboard/src/main returned zero matches, and gradle/libs.versions.toml plus app/build.gradle.kts:112-153 declare no analytics, ads, crash-reporting or HTTP SDK (only AndroidX, Compose, Hilt, Room, DataStore, Coroutines). Additionally this code is compiled only into the non-shipping 'forschung' product flavor (app/build.gradle.kts:78-82, applicationIdSuffix ".forschung"); the shipped 'offline' flavor manifest (app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:1-28) declares only RECORD_AUDIO and no INTERNET/ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE, and app/build.gradle.kts:177-222 registers a 'pruefeNetzfreiheit' Gradle gate that fails the build if a network permission ever appears in the offline flavor's merged manifest.
findings.recommendation: No action required for Play compliance: the device/hardware descriptors never leave the device and the code is not part of the shipped 'offline' flavor. Keep the pruefeNetzfreiheit gate in CI so the offline flavor can never acquire INTERNET, and never publish the 'forschung' flavor to Play. If a diagnostic upload is ever added to this report path, DEVICE_ID must be declared as collected in the Data Safety form.
findings.purpose: Local functionality only (on-device microphone/hardware diagnostics in the non-shipping research flavor)

findings.evidence: Prozessbefund.kt:38-45 collects process performance telemetry (CPU time from /proc/self/stat, open fd count from /proc/self/fd, thread count, Java heap via Runtime, native heap via android.os.Debug.getNativeHeapAllocatedSize() at line 43, RSS from /proc/self/statm). Consumers are all research measurement runners in the same non-shipping flavor (Streckendauerlauf.kt:217,234,279; Sitzungsdauerlauf.kt:330; Dauerversuch.kt:215,313), which format the values into a text report that reaches the same local sink as above -- ForschungActivity.kt:374-380 writes it to getExternalFilesDir and logcat only. No telemetry/crash SDK is present (gradle/libs.versions.toml has no Firebase, Crashlytics, Mixpanel, Adjust or AppsFlyer entry) and no HTTP client exists in the codebase, so the Logger-Loop heuristic finds no off-device diagnostic payload. The two additional flagged 'trace' hits are false positives and are not diagnostics collection at all: app/src/main/res/values-en/strings.xml:108 is marketing/onboarding copy ("no account, no network, no traces") and app/src/main/res/values-fr/strings.xml:127 is the privacy-screen sentence ("Nibra ne demande aucun acces reseau, n'a ni compte, ni paiement, ni traceurs").
findings.recommendation: No action required: performance diagnostics stay on-device and exist only in the research flavor. If a crash/performance SDK (Crashlytics, Firebase Performance) is ever added to the shipped flavor, declare PERFORMANCE_DIAGNOSTICS as collected in the Data Safety form and update the in-app privacy screen text, which currently promises no network access at all.
findings.purpose: Local functionality only (on-device memory/CPU measurement for research builds)

findings.issue_summary: Data Safety Compliant (Local-Only) -- semantic false positive, no purchase or transaction data exists in the app
findings.evidence: Semantic grounding rejects the match. The 'invoice' pattern at Sprachlauf.kt:511 ("The invoice for eight hundred euros has already been paid. ") and its German twin at Sprachlauf.kt:521 ("Die Rechnung ueber achthundert Euro ist bereits bezahlt. ") are hard-coded literals inside bezugstextFuer(), the fixed reference sentence that a tester reads aloud so speech-recognition accuracy can be scored word-by-word (class doc at Sprachlauf.kt:22-47 describes the controlled dictation run with an identical spoken text in both passes). The string is compiled-in test copy, not a user's purchase or transaction record, and it is never read from any billing, Play Billing or payment source -- Sprachlauf.kt imports only android.speech / android.media / EinstellungenAblage, and the project declares no billing dependency in gradle/libs.versions.toml or app/build.gradle.kts:112-153. No purchase data is collected, stored or transmitted anywhere in the app.
findings.recommendation: Do not declare PURCHASE_HISTORY in the Play Data Safety form; the app handles no purchases. No code change needed. Optionally reword the research reference sentence to avoid future automated scanners flagging it.
findings.purpose: Local functionality only (hard-coded reference text for on-device recognition accuracy measurement)

findings.issue_summary: Manual Sharing: Policy Exempt. The user triggers the transfer to a third-party app of their choice via the Android Share Sheet; no prominent disclosure and no Data Safety declaration are required.
findings.evidence: MainActivity.kt:204-211 defines the 'teile' (share) lambda: Intent(Intent.ACTION_SEND) with type = "text/plain" (line 207) and putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_TEXT, text) (line 208), dispatched through context.startActivity(Intent.createChooser(absicht, null)) at line 210. The payload is the user's own dictated text, and createChooser guarantees the user must pick the receiving app, so the transfer is user_initiated and the destination is a user-selected third party per the Share Sheet rule. The sibling paths are on-device only: MainActivity.kt:196-197 and 220-221 place the same text on the system clipboard via ClipboardManager.setPrimaryClip(ClipData.newPlainText("Nibra", text)), and MainActivity.kt:213 hands it to Dienstbruecke.fuegeEin() (the app's own accessibility service, declared android:exported="false" in app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:53-65) -- both are user-triggered actions, not silent transfers. There is no silent background egress: the shipped 'offline' flavor has no INTERNET permission and the codebase contains no HTTP client. Supporting in-app transparency exists at app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml:152-160 (Datenschutz screen: "Alles bleibt auf diesem Geraet.", "Nibra fordert kein Recht auf Netzzugang an, hat kein Konto, keine Bezahlung und keine Tracker."), rendered by DatenschutzBildschirm.kt.
findings.recommendation: No action required. Manual sharing through Intent.createChooser is exempt from both prominent disclosure and the Data Safety collection declaration, so FILES_AND_DOCS should not be declared as collected on account of this code path. Keep using createChooser rather than targeting a fixed package, so the user always chooses the recipient.
findings.purpose: App functionality (user-initiated sharing of their own dictated text to an app they select)
